customer_message.subject: Contesting termination of my lease at Gartenweg 86, Aarau
customer_message.body: Hi, my name is Drew Palmer and I live at Gartenweg 86 in Aarau, a 3.5-room flat rented from Wincasa Nord AG. | My wife lives here with me. This flat is our family home and has been for several years, so it matters a lot to us. | Wincasa wants to end our lease and I want to contest that. I need help understanding my options. | I have not yet decided whether to go to the conciliation authority first or to speak to a lawyer, and I am not sure which route makes sense in our situation. | Could you tell me whether your legal expenses cover a challenge to the termination, and what the next steps would be? | I can send you the lease contract and our correspondence with Wincasa so far. I can also scan anything else you need. | I would prefer to talk by phone. Evenings work best for me, my wife is usually home after 18:00 too, so we could both join if that helps. | Thanks a lot for your help, Drew
